mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% over three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which depresses earnings for industrial firms and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of three consecutive months of >1% INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and core CPI inflation above 2% for two consecutive months signals a dual monetary and inflationary shock, which increases real interest rates and erodes equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous and CPIAUCSL > 202 (index) for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their previous values and CPIAUCSL > 202 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average by more than 10% for three consecutive months signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month moving average by >10% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average by more than 10% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over two consecutive months indicates population reclassification or labor force re-entry without job creation, which signals weak labor demand and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE rises in two consecutive months
regime_hint: labor force re-entry without job creation
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS and UNRATE both rise for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals elevated precautionary savings and reduced consumer spending, which depresses corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average for five consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months.
